items.title: Henry A. "Hank" Kmen Interview, 1963-02-13
items.q: You see, you'd come in and sort of say, Benny sent me here, Joe sent me.

ctx.x: And so it was nothing for a leader to go in the union hall and hire a band, you know, engage the different musicians. And then when he got on the job he was apt to find that half of them or even more were guys he hadn't seen before. You see, you'd come in and sort of say, Benny sent me here, Joe sent me. And this was alright so long as you cut the job. You didn't jeopardize the connection of the guy that had booked it. This was common practice.
So long as you could read stocks. Read stocks was about all that.
